description: Tool to list SubpropertySyncConfig resources for managing subproperty synchronization configurations. Use when you need to fetch subproperty sync configs for a GA4 property.

inputSchema.description: Request model for listing SubpropertySyncConfig resources.

pageSize.description: Optional. The maximum number of resources to return. May return fewer. If unspecified, at most 50 resources will be returned. Maximum value is 200.
pageSize.title: Page Size

pageToken.description: Optional. A page token received from a previous ListSubpropertySyncConfig call. Provide this to retrieve the subsequent page.
pageToken.title: Page Token

parent.description: Required. Resource name of the property. Format: properties/{property_id}. Example: properties/123
parent.title: Parent

inputSchema.title: ListSubpropertySyncConfigsRequest

name: list_subproperty_sync_configs

ListSubpropertySyncConfigsResponse.description: Response model for listing SubpropertySyncConfig resources.

nextPageToken.description: A token which can be sent as pageToken to retrieve the next page. If this field is omitted, there are no subsequent pages.
nextPageToken.title: Next Page Token

subpropertySyncConfigs.description: List of SubpropertySyncConfig resources associated with the property.
subpropertySyncConfigs.title: Subproperty Sync Configs

ListSubpropertySyncConfigsResponse.title: ListSubpropertySyncConfigsResponse

applyToProperty.description: Output only, immutable. Specifies the subproperty resource these settings apply to.
applyToProperty.title: Apply To Property

customDimensionAndMetricSyncMode.description: Required. Controls custom dimension/metric synchronization behavior. ALL: entities synchronized from parent; NONE: entities not synchronized.
customDimensionAndMetricSyncMode.title: Custom Dimension And Metric Sync Mode
